content.title: Refinancing of Flagship Manhattan Asset Might Change the Case for Investing in Vornado Realty Trust (VNO)
content.summary: Vornado Realty Trust recently completed a US$120 million refinancing of 4 Union Square South, a 204,000 square foot retail property in Manhattan, securing a ten-year, interest-only loan at a fixed 5.64% rate to replace an expiring floating rate loan. This refinancing locks in stable interest costs and extends the debt maturity, enhancing Vornado's financial flexibility amid shifting interest rate conditions. We'll examine how this move to fixed-rate, long-term financing for a flagship asset...
